name: Krishna
summary: The Supreme Personality of Godhead and primary focus of the Srimad Bhagavatam, known for His divine pastimes in Vrindavan, Mathura, and Dvaraka.

name: Brahmā
summary: Brahmā is the primary deity of creation within the universal cosmic order responsible for engineering the manifest material cosmos.

name: Vyasadeva
summary: The revered sage and compiler of the Vedas who authored the Mahabharata, Puranas, and the Srimad Bhagavatam.

name: Naimiṣāraṇya
summary: A holy, auspicious forest where thousands of sages gathered under Shaunaka Rishi to hear the recitation of the Srimad Bhagavatam.

name: Śukadeva Gosvāmī
summary: The exalted self-realized sage and son of Vyasadeva who originally recited the Srimad Bhagavatam to King Parikshit.
